subsections.title: Hidden Cameras
subsections.blurb: Pinhole and disguised cams for discreet, lawful indoor use.

products.title: Dice-Style Hidden Nanny Cam 1080p
products.body_html:
Camera disguised as a table-top dice ornament. Blends into kid rooms, nurseries, desks. 1080p, motion-activated recording, USB powered.

  • Disguised as decorative dice
  • 1080p motion-triggered record
  • Night vision
  • MicroSD (up to 128GB)

products.title: Mini Wireless WiFi Nanny Cam — Palm-Size
products.body_html:
Fits in a bookshelf or stuffed-animal pouch. WiFi streaming, motion alerts, night vision. The most popular discreet-monitor format in 2026.

  • 1080p HD, palm-size form factor
  • WiFi live stream + MicroSD backup
  • Night vision (IR, invisible to subject)
  • Motion + sound alerts to phone

products.title: Amcrest 1080p Nanny + Pet WiFi Camera
products.body_html:
Brand-name Amcrest nanny cam. 1080p, two-way audio, motion + sound detection. Works with the Amcrest View app (iOS, Android) and integrates with Google / Alexa.

  • 1080p HD, 120° viewing
  • Sound detection (triggers on crying/barking)
  • Pan, tilt, zoom from app
  • Cloud or MicroSD storage

products.title: 2K Pan-Tilt Pet + Baby Camera with Smart Tracking
products.body_html:
Higher-resolution 2K (2304×1296) indoor camera with AI-assisted motion tracking. Auto-follows the subject, one-touch talk button, Alexa compatible.

  • 2K resolution (2304×1296)
  • Smart motion tracking — camera follows movement
  • Alexa voice control for live-view
  • MicroSD up to 128GB, free 30-day cloud trial

products.title: 1080p Pan-Tilt-Zoom Indoor Pet/Baby Monitor
products.body_html:
Full-range 360° indoor monitor. 355° horizontal / 110° vertical PTZ with 4x digital zoom. Two-way talk, night vision to 30ft. Ships same-to-next day from California warehouse.

  • 1080p HD at 30fps, H.264
  • Pan / tilt / 4x digital zoom
  • US warehouse (California) — same/next day shipping
  • Motion alerts with 10-sec clips to phone

products.title: Wireless 1080p Indoor Security Camera
products.body_html:
Entry-level indoor WiFi camera. Crisp 1080p feed, two-way audio, night vision, MicroSD + cloud storage. Smart-home friendly via app.

  • 1080p H.264 encoding
  • Two-way audio (built-in mic + speaker)
  • Night vision to ~30ft
  • Cloud backup or local MicroSD (up to 128GB)

products.title: Mini Hidden Nanny Cam 1080p
products.body_html:
Thumb-sized hidden cam for indoor use. Loops onto MicroSD, triggers on motion. Fits in a bookshelf, smoke-detector casing, or desktop clutter.

  • 1080p full HD, ~30fps
  • Motion-activated + continuous modes
  • Night vision via built-in IR LEDs (~15ft range)
  • USB powered for 24/7, or built-in battery for ~2hr portable

products.title: Pocket Pen HD Hidden Camera
products.body_html:
1080p HD camera disguised as a working ballpoint pen. Silent record, no visible lens. Built-in rechargeable battery for ~90 minutes continuous, MicroSD storage up to 32GB.

  • Recording: 1080p MP4 at 30fps
  • Battery: ~90 min continuous
  • Trigger: single button, tactile feedback
  • Comes with USB-C cable + pen ink refill

products.title: 4K Mini WiFi Pinhole Hidden Camera
products.body_html:
Pinhole-lens hidden WiFi camera. Tiny enough to mount inside a DIY enclosure (screw head, book, smoke detector). Streams 4K via app, logs to SD card or cloud.

  • Resolution: 4K via app, 1080p local
  • Motion-triggered alerts + night vision
  • Works with iOS + Android
  • MicroSD up to 128GB supported

subsections.title: Indoor Cameras
subsections.blurb: Pan-tilt and static WiFi cams for home interiors.

subsections.title: Outdoor Cameras
subsections.blurb: Weatherproof IP65/IP66 cams, wired and solar.

products.title: Solar-Powered Outdoor WiFi Camera with Night Vision
products.body_html:
Solar-charged outdoor camera — no wiring, no outlet. IP66-rated, 1920×1080, digital zoom. Ideal for driveways, gates, barns, and backyards without power runs.

  • Solar panel integrated — runs on sunlight
  • IP66 waterproof
  • 1080p with digital zoom
  • Cloud + MicroSD (16/32/64/128GB options)

products.title: 1080p IP66 Outdoor WiFi Bullet Camera
products.body_html:
IP66-rated outdoor bullet cam. Compact 1.5" barrel that blends into siding or eaves. 1080p HD, supports up to 64GB MicroSD storage.

  • IP66 fully waterproof
  • 1080p HD, 30fps
  • -5°C to +55°C range
  • Supports US + EU power adapters

products.title: IP65 Outdoor WiFi Camera V380 Pro
products.body_html:
Weather-sealed IP65 outdoor camera. -20°C to +40°C operating range. Infrared night vision to 30 meters. Alarm function + two-way audio.

  • IP65 waterproof
  • Night vision to 30m (100ft)
  • V380 Pro app (iOS + Android)
  • Operating range: -20°C to +40°C

products.title: Smart Wireless Video Doorbell with Night Vision
products.body_html:
Premium wireless video doorbell. Built-in IR night vision for dark porches, chime included, simple 2-wire mount.

  • Night vision to ~20ft
  • Wireless chime included
  • 1080p video + motion zones
  • Setup in under 10 minutes

products.title: Smart WiFi Video Doorbell M7 with Remote Monitoring
products.body_html:
Hard-wired or battery, your choice. 1080p wide-angle feed, PIR motion detection, two-way voice. Pairs with most smart-home platforms.

  • 1080p wide-angle camera
  • PIR motion sensor (reduces false alerts)
  • Two-way voice via phone app
  • Cloud clip storage (free tier) or MicroSD

products.title: Battery-Powered WiFi Video Doorbell
products.body_html:
No-wire video doorbell — rechargeable battery, no electrician needed. Two-way audio, motion alerts, 1080p live view from phone.

  • Battery powered (rechargeable via USB-C)
  • 1080p live view + motion clips
  • Two-way talk from phone
  • Night vision + HDR

subsections.title: Dash Cameras
subsections.blurb: Single and dual-lens car dashcams with night vision.

products.title: 1080p Touch-Screen Dashcam with CarPlay
products.body_html:
Full-screen touch dashcam. CarPlay-compatible variant lets you mirror phone maps/music on the dash display. 170° front, 720p rear, loop recording.

  • Touchscreen UI
  • CarPlay + WiFi variants available
  • 170° front camera + 720p rear
  • 4K + 1080p + CarPlay top-tier option

products.title: 4-Inch IPS Dual-Channel Starlight Night-Vision Dashcam
products.body_html:
4-inch IPS display dashcam with starlight sensor for crisp night footage. Front + rear cam capture, wide-angle lens, 12MP still photos.

  • 4" IPS display
  • Front & rear dual channel
  • Starlight night vision sensor
  • 1080p front, 480p rear

products.title: Dual-Lens B6T Dashcam 12MP, 170° View
products.body_html:
Slim dashcam (120×65×8mm) that mounts behind the rearview mirror. 12 megapixel sensor, 170° wide view, 30M/s USB transfer for quick clip exports.

  • 12 megapixel, 170° wide angle
  • Up to 32GB MicroSD (∼16 hr of footage)
  • 12V-to-5V cigarette-lighter power
  • Loop recording with G-sensor lock on impact
